sam: Quick sync — INC-612 postmortem items. Need firm commitments and dates so I can include in Friday's exec update. Can everyone drop status + final due date here?

maria: I can take the root cause writeup (item 2). Draft by Wed EOD, final by Thu after reviews. @sam will share notes. :pencil:

ajay: Working on DB migration rollback safeguards (item 1). Patch ready, running validation now. ETA Thu 10am PT, can do canary that afternoon.

liz: Owning the rollout/canary plan (item 4). Blocked on infra ticket 8942 for subnet cleanup. I filed a lean request, @eng-infra please prioritize? If infra clears by tomorrow I can run canary Fri.

dylan: I'll handle perf regression tests (item 3). Running baseline tonight, aim to post results Tue morning. If perf looks good, I'll flip the config for a small cohort Wed.

maria: also adding follow-ups to the GH issue (redwood/infra#612-rca). Will tag reviewers.

sam: Thanks. Couple of clarifications: (a) If infra can't clear subnet by tomorrow, what's the fallback? (b) Who can own customer comms draft?

liz: fallback is to limit rollout to region-us-west-2 only. I can draft the comms with @maria help.

ajay: If rollback is needed, I can own the execute steps; need one more person to ack the playbook during rollback window. @dylan can you be the second?

dylan: I can be on-call for the rollback window Thu 9-11am PT.

incident-bot: Assignment summary updated: item1:@ajay, item2:@maria, item3:@dylan, item4:@liz. Link: https://redwood.internal/rca/INC-612

sam: Nice. For the exec update I need a compact table — please confirm final due dates here.

maria: item2 -> Thu 2026-03-19 EOD
ajay: item1 -> Thu 2026-03-19 10:00 PT (validation)
dylan: item3 -> Tue 2026-03-17 AM results, Wed 2026-03-18 small cohort flip
liz: item4 -> Fri 2026-03-20 canary (if infra ready), fallback plan -> region-limited rollout Fri PM

sam: Perfect. I'm pasting a tiny action table below for the exec deck. If anything changes, update the GH issue and ping me. :eyes:

```
INC-612 action snapshot
- item1: DB migration safeguards — owner: ajay — due: 2026-03-19 10:00 PT
- item2: RCA writeup — owner: maria — due: 2026-03-19 EOD
- item3: Perf tests + cohort flip — owner: dylan — results: 2026-03-17, flip: 2026-03-18
- item4: Rollout + canary — owner: liz — target: 2026-03-20 (fallback: limited to us-west-2)
```

liz: I'll update the canary runbook and post link here when ready.

ajay: I'll add the rollback playbook steps to the issue and tag @sam for the final ack.

sam: Thanks everyone — I'll include this snapshot in the exec update. If infra delays happen, we'll reconvene async here and adjust dates. :thumbsup:
